revision_note: 2026-10-16 block revision after known-item testing of run OPENALEX-20261016-02: C_task adds corrosion/fault/flaw/quality control (P01 missed); D_ai adds learning-paradigm terms because industrial anomaly-detection abstracts often omit generic AI terms (B02 missed); OA-T added because OpenAlex lacks abstracts for some publisher records (P08, P03 missed). Removing D_ai entirely was tested and rejected (uncertainty family 5,485 hits dominated by measurement uncertainty).
revision_note_2: 2026-10-22 after known-item test of OPENALEX-20261022-01 (6/11 core calibration records retrieved): misses used generic words in titles (Reliable, calibrated, grounded) or lacked industrial context terms while evaluating on industrial benchmarks. Added OA-G (generic reliability words restricted to titles; abstract-wide generic words gave 8,100 hits) and OA-C (citation-based family on the dominant industrial anomaly benchmark). Run as OPENALEX-20261022-02.
revision_note_3: 2026-10-23: citation tracing families OA-CTF1-4 (forward, cites:) and OA-CTB1-4 (backward, cited_by:) over the 156 included studies that have OpenAlex IDs (P03 is not indexed), restricted by the same reliability vocabulary as OA-C (EG_citation_reliability).
